title: Context API & Redux Toolkit
description: Master React Context for global state and Redux Toolkit for complex state management with TypeScript.

data.text: React Context provides a way to pass data through the component tree without prop drilling. Use it for global theme, user, or app-wide state.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Context avoids prop drilling for global state
Create context with createContext, provide with Provider
Split contexts by domain to avoid unnecessary re-renders
Redux Toolkit simplifies Redux with createSlice and configureStore
data.takeaway: Use Context for simple global state and Redux Toolkit for complex state with actions, reducers, and middleware. Both work well with TypeScript.
